The canonical knowledge-profile installer copies Architrave assets into
.github/agents/, .github/hooks/, gates/, harness/, and knowledge/, and
generates the managed AGENTS.md stanza, config, and setup workflow.
Those upstream assets retain their MIT license. The Apache-2.0 license
for original EACH code does not replace Architrave's upstream notice.
